newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent firmer, NYMEX holds earlier gains.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent firmer, NYMEX holds earlier gains.

text.p: Brent crude futures were firmer in late trading on Thursday in Asia as NYMEX extended day-earlier gains on continued short covering.
April Brent on SIMEX was last traded at $19.76 per barrel, up 15 cents from London. Volume was a modest 32 lots.
May Brent was last traded at $19.55, up 16 cents from London. The contract attracted most volume -- at 219 lots -- as players focused on May ahead of April's expiry on Friday.
Traders said the gains were built largely on the NYMEX rise, although an eight cargo cut in the Brent loading programme for April from March was also supporting sentiment.
The lower programme was the result of refinery maintenance schedules, traders said.
April NYMEX crude, on ACCESS, was last traded at $20.82, up 20 cents from New York.
Brokers said a mixture of an extension of the day-earlier rally and options expiry-related trading supported the price.
Earlier, one player on ACCESS pushed the contract to its intraday high of $21.11 in a search for stops.
